title: FizzBuzz Fumble
description: fizzbuzz(n) returns the list from 1 to n where multiples of 3 become "Fizz", multiples of 5 become "Buzz" and multiples of both become "FizzBuzz".
hint: For i = 15, which branch of the if/elif chain runs first?
explanation: An `if/elif` chain stops at the first true condition. 15 is divisible by 3, so it becomes "Fizz" before the `% 15` check is ever reached. Put the most specific condition first.
